description: The Municipality of Livorno publishes geographic and tabular descriptions of nursery, preschool and primary-school facilities. The source lists each school's name, short and extended description, type, offered services, address and postcode. Nursery and preschool entries additionally describe access arrangements. The geographic files collectively form Shapefiles in EPSG:3003, and the source also lists CSV tables with the stated attributes. Municipal statistical staff prepared the information from education-office and civil-protection inputs. The nursery and preschool entries belong to the named schools series; the primary-school entry is independently published with the same municipal purpose and field structure. These complementary facility categories are grouped, with the general series retained as an overlapping parent. The data do not establish enrolment capacity, current pupil numbers, structural condition or a specific simulation use. Related municipal building and emergency-planning records have different coverage. The three facility layers state CC BY 4.0, while the general series metadata states CC BY-SA 2.0. These component-specific rights remain distinct. Current facility operation, geometry accuracy and download availability have not been tested. No school table, map or feature collection was opened.
